title: Double and Halve
summary: Double one number and halve the other to make the sum easy.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: 25 is a quarter of 100, so use that.
points: 25 is a quarter of 100, so use that.

steps.title: The method: Double one, halve the other
sentences: Halve 16 to get 8, and double 25 to get 50.
Do it again: halve 8 to 4, double 50 to 100.
points: Halve 16 to get 8, and double 25 to get 50.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Doubling one number and halving the other does not change the product.
Pick the halving that makes a friendly number.
